featured_reviews.name: Imran Khan
featured_reviews.review_text: Huge open ground for wedding function etc. Parking also available. Near from Santacruz and Vile Parle station. Decoration is excellent.

featured_reviews.name: Aniket Gawde
featured_reviews.review_text:
Ground is easily accessible from Vile Parle or Santacruz railway station.
You can drive using car or bike by SV road or Milan subway to reach here. Ground is very suitable for marriage ceremony or any other functions.
There is ample of space for parking two wheeler and four wheeler. There are toilets for men's and women's.
Ground is nicely decorated for marriage function when I visited. Entry gate was well decorated and occupied with Marathi Traditional Tutari wala. Food served was also amazing. Jalebi Rabdi and Gulab Jamun Rabadi was too good. Chinese and Indian Cuisine were also available. Capacity of ground can be around 1000-1500 people. As this is open space it doesn't look too crowded.

featured_reviews.name: Amogh T.
featured_reviews.review_text:
This is an excellent Banquet Hall located in the heart of Khar West in a bylane.

There are 2 main areas - the primary hall on 1st floor for functions and the dining area on ground floor which can easily fit around a dozen large tables.

The entry and internal decoration is well done and lavish.

Food menu has large variety across multiple budget ranges.

Street parking is less but they provide valet parking service.

featured_reviews.name: Vyom
featured_reviews.review_text:
GA Kulkarni Banquet is a well-designed, spacious venue ideal for gatherings and rotating public. The hall offers ample space, comfortably accommodating around 200 guests in a compact yet efficient layout. The main stage stands out with its impressive décor and excellent lighting, making it perfect for events and ceremonies.

Outside, there is sufficient road space for easy movement and parking convenience.
The highlight of the banquet, however, was the food every item was top-notch, and guests genuinely appreciated the taste and quality.

A great venue overall for functions and celebrations.

featured_reviews.name: Rushikesh patwardhan
featured_reviews.review_text: Awsome luxurious hall with good amenities and very well managed staff with all traditional female staff with navari saadi with huge weeding hall and decoration was amazing enjoyed today's wedding event extremely happy

featured_reviews.name: Mokshada Mihir Hardas
featured_reviews.review_text:
The event of my son's "Upanayan" was one of it's kind!
The entire team put up an unforgettable experience for each and every person present. The ambiance, the decor, the arrangements, the staff and especially the food was something that will remain with us forever. Every instruction and finer details were taken care of. I would specially like to mention the wonderful setup of "Acharya Kutiya" which was brought to life with jute fabric, fresh flowers and coconut leaves; graceful yet subtle, elegant yet simple! The food was typically prepared to suit maharashtrian brahmin sensibilities and was served on fresh banana leaves taking the culinary experience a notch up.
Mr. Shashank Kadam is a man of fine taste and understanding and it reflects in his work. His passion for what he does makes a simple event an experience to remember for a lifetime. You rock team Ameeta !!!

featured_reviews.name: Richa Karve
featured_reviews.review_text: We had a stall at the Mumbai festive Bazaar - Greener Diwali 2019. The banquet is really lavish and has a soothing ambiance.

featured_reviews.name: Dr. Hemant Kumar Tantia
featured_reviews.review_text:
Forum decorators also known as Hiravati Banquet Hall, is a wedding hall, ideally located in Santa Cruz (west) Mumbai. It has the capacity to accommodate 400 +  people for a reception function. It possesses an AC hall for the function , a beautiful green lawn and a big Air-conditioned dinning hall. Ambience of this place is very pleasant . Entrance is very beautiful & well decorated with verities of flowers and lights. Catering service is excellent and they serve  delicious food.
The only drawback is non availability of parking facility inside the compound. Therefore, you have to park your car on the road side. Overall a very good place for wedding and reception in a reasonable budget.**** 4 or 4.5 out of 5.   "Excellent"

featured_reviews.name: Jitendra Gala
featured_reviews.review_text: Excellent AC Hall for Functions,Ample Height inside the hall for Easy Air Serculation and a Specious place for Lunch/Dinner which is Indoor as well Outside Open Space, The Food & Services from Rajesh Caterers was Excellent,Really a Good Experience, Thankyou🙏

featured_reviews.name: Rohan Mehta
featured_reviews.review_text: Hiravati Banquet is a spacious and well-designed venue, perfect for large gatherings. The interior is elegant and adds a classy touch to any event. The only drawback was the food—I'm not sure if it was their in-house catering or an external service, but it could have been better. Overall, a great place for hosting grand celebrations.

featured_reviews.name: Mayur Deshmukh
featured_reviews.review_text:
Hiravati Banquet Hall, Santacruz is an excellent venue for hosting mid-sized events like weddings, engagements, or receptions. The place is surprisingly quiet and peaceful, making it perfect for intimate yet elegant gatherings.

It has a separate dining hall, which helps manage the event flow smoothly, and the entrance lobby offers a comfortable sitting area — ideal for arranging small interactive activities like a caricature artist or photo booth.

The AC and lighting setup are top-notch, adding a touch of luxury to any celebration. Overall, a well-maintained and thoughtfully designed banquet hall that makes every event feel special.

Highly recommended!

featured_reviews.name: Ramnik Sheth
featured_reviews.review_text: About - Hiravati banquet hall is well maintained, decoration is good, but but very costly, situated in Santacruz at Tagore Road is a very narrow road location for traffic, monopoly in catering service & also costly, behavior of catering manager is rough as per last week experience.

featured_reviews.name: Ashish
featured_reviews.review_text:
Banquet is good for 300-400 people, beyond that would feel crowded and may require more management.
Hall itself is well lit and the decor is decent.
Catering was fine, food quality no complaint in general, but didn't have anything special or standing out either.
Okay for smaller functions or lesser guests.
Parking is available, but fills up soon due to limited space. It looked like the basketball court of the school being used as parking lot.
Check the amount of cars they can accept, if you host any event here and don't want your guests to suffer!

featured_reviews.name: Vijith Shetty
featured_reviews.review_text: This place can accommodate roughly 300-350 people. So you will majorly see birthdays and small reception events being conducted here. I liked the decoration at the entrance path, it was simple yet beautiful, blended well with the occasion. The ambience in the hall too is quite impressive. It seems like they have vegetarian option only (I'm not 100% sure). The food was quite good and depends on how much you want to spend, based on which the variety is decided. The hall rates are reasonable as well. Good place to conduct an event!!

featured_reviews.name: Pooja Kothari
featured_reviews.review_text:
Held our sangeet event at Ajivasan banquet and the event was at another level.
They not only customised according to our wishes but also met above our expectations
Awesome theme decor, selfie counter all were too perfect
Food was another level especially edamame candy was too good!!!
Completely Recommended

featured_reviews.review_text: Reasonably good banquet hall facilty and equally good catering and decoration provisions. Parking space is restricted though. featured_reviews.name: Bernardine Alphonso Fernandes
featured_reviews.review_text:
We recently hosted our Roce ceremony here, and it turned out to be a truly memorable and joyful celebration. The banquet hall was beautifully decorated according to our theme, exactly as I had requested, and it provided the perfect setting for our special day.

The staff were professional, friendly, and very supportive in ensuring everything was well organized. Their attention to detail and hospitality really stood out throughout the event. I had shared a small suggestion regarding the portion size of the starter menu, which they kindly acknowledged and assured us they would consider for the future.

The main course was excellent—served fresh and hot, which is something guests always appreciate.

Overall, everything was handled very well. Ola, Thank you for helping make our celebration so special. This is really a great place for anyone looking to host family events.
Highly recommended!

featured_reviews.name: Shraddha Mestry
featured_reviews.review_text:
We celebrated our parents 30th anniversary at Ola Vakkola and honestly, they made the whole evening a seamless experience.

From the first call to the final goodbye, their responses were prompt. Every request was handled quickly, no chasing or follow-ups needed.

The team is genuinely warm and helpful. They listened to what we wanted and went out of their way to make sure everything ran smooth.

Decor was elegant, exactly as planned. Music setup was on point, and the food was fresh, delicious, and loved by all our guests.

The event was a total hit because of their prompt service and cooperative attitude. If you want a stress-free celebration with great food, music, and vibe, Ola Vakkola is the place.

Highly recommended! ✨

featured_reviews.name: Komal Torne
featured_reviews.review_text:
We recently celebrated my mother's 61st Birthday At this beautiful banquet, I gave given 1 less star for little low AC, no parking facility, very high charges for delay in closer, no lift or special staircase for wheelchair, low light on stage

4 stars for other facilities like mesmerizing decoration, amazing energetic game host sagar who kept the guest engaged and active with his games, our guest enjoyed all games very much, very cooperative and humble event manager deepak who was available on site for full time assistance, good sound facility, cleanliness of washrooms , hall and sparrow room. All guest loved the hall ambience very much.
Thank you for making our special day most memorable. 💗

featured_reviews.name: Samiksha Nade
featured_reviews.review_text:
We recently celebrated our daughter’s naming ceremony at Ola Banquet, Vakola, and the entire experience was truly memorable. The hall was beautifully maintained—clean, spacious, and perfect for a family gathering. The decor was elegant and added a lovely charm to our special day.

The staff was very professional and cooperative throughout the planning and the event. They ensured everything was in place and executed smoothly. The food was another highlight—delicious, well-prepared, and thoroughly enjoyed by all our guests.

We are really happy we chose Ola Banquet for this important day. Highly recommended for anyone looking for a great venue in Santacruz/Vakola!

featured_reviews.name: Ashvita Shetty
featured_reviews.review_text:
We recently hosted a small event at this banquet hall, and the experience exceeded our expectations. The team was extremely attentive and always on their toes, making sure all our requirements were met promptly and efficiently.

The food was delicious and well-received by all our guests, and the service throughout the event was smooth and professional. Everything was handled with care, which made the occasion stress-free for us.

Overall, we’re very happy with how everything turned out and would definitely recommend this venue to others looking for a reliable and well-managed space.

featured_reviews.name: Girish Surgical Works
featured_reviews.review_text: I recently had the pleasure of celebrating a Kelvan for our teammate, Shweta Madam, and it exceeded all expectations! The Ola Vakola Banquet Hall was clean and comfortable, the amenities were top-notch, and the location was perfect. The food (both veg and non-veg) was excellent and truly up to the mark. A special thanks to the sandesh sir even his team was friendly and helpful staff for making it a great experience

featured_reviews.name: Pravesh Shrivas
featured_reviews.review_text: We recently celebrated our child’s first birthday, and it was an absolutely wonderful experience! The event was beautifully organized, with every detail taken care of perfectly. The decorations were stunning and created a festive and joyful atmosphere. The food was delicious and enjoyed by all our guests. The DJ and sound setup were fantastic, adding so much energy and fun to the celebration—everyone had a great time dancing! Everything ran smoothly, making the day truly special for us and our little one. A big thank you to everyone involved in making this celebration so memorable! Highly recommended!

featured_reviews.name: Priti Shejwal
featured_reviews.review_text: Here at Ola Vakola Banquet, My engagement event went well.  Everything was good—food, décor, and all the staff members were cooperative. The only thing I didn’t like was that full payment had to be made before the event. Apart from that, the overall experience was good.

Stayed here for 4 days.
Very great service.
Mr Janak helped us bringing food. Shevpoori, wadapao all Mumbai delights . Paan he helped us in buying.

Mr Sanjay manager was so cooperative.
We came late night from the show he ordered Roti n Sabji for us in the midnight.
Very safe place, pure vegetarian place.
Lady can stay safely  alone in that hotel.

featured_reviews.name: Anirudh Rangarajan
featured_reviews.review_text:
Awfully maintained place... Inadequate facilities... Water will only be available during certain hours when BMC water comes, else they shut off the connection and you have to keep calling them to turn it back on, which they do only for 20-30 mins... When asked why don't they just leave it on as its problematic for guests, they say "pehle hi bola tha paani nahi aayega din bhar, aap baar baar kyun poochte ho?"
Moreover there are seepages, mold etc. everywhere.. Unfortunately missed clicking photos..
Would never recommend to anyone ever...
